rca of the issue: Documents upload 500 root cause: /app/backend/routers/documents.py:51 calls put_object() → /app/backend/storage.py:23 calls init_storage() → POST to https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/init with header authorization=EMERGENT_LLM_KEY receives HTTP 401 'key is not active'. resp.raise_for_status() raises requests.exceptions.HTTPError which bubbles up as FastAPI 500. Reproduction: any authenticated driver POST /api/documents/upload with valid multipart body. Mitigation options: (1) rotate/reactivate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY [preferred, external]; (2) catch HTTPError in storage.init_storage and raise HTTPException(503, detail={'code':'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE'}) so the frontend shows a graceful message instead of 500 [minor UX polish]. Not tested/fixed here per review request instruction.
